doc.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Carnegie Hall, Rosemary Clooney and the Queen Mary album
summary: Competition among LA players, Carnegie Hall concerts, and a new live album.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Oh yeah now we get just everybody. The competition, well it makes everybody play — everybody is playing great.
You ever get back to New York to play? I shouldn’t say back, do you ever go to New York to play?

Yeah. I’ve been there. What was the last time, oh yeah Carnegie Hall with Rosemary Clooney, yeah that was a thrill, God I loved her. And I’ve done Carnegie Hall with Benny a few times, we did the 40 year anniversary, and then I did a few concerts with Benny back then, and I got to go back with Rosemary Clooney, we did a tribute to Bing Crosby. I love here, she’s a great artist.
I see you’ve got a couple of albums out with the Jack Sheldon Orchestra.
Yeah. I have a new one coming out, live on the Queen Mary, so that will be good.
Is that the one that parked down in Long Beach is it?
Yeah, it’s not going anywhere, but it’s nice though. It’s this big boat. And we did something there with the big band, it was great.
